insights.one_liner: Electronics retailer's Benelux head office in De Rotterdam; has a mid-level finance role that needs no Dutch.

culture.text: Says staff act as entrepreneurs inside the company, with freedom to shape their role and grow quickly.
The Benelux office is in the De Rotterdam building.
